title: The Rock Oasis Inc.
specs: 8 Perfect Descent auto belays servicing 24 routes
Routes of varying difficulty from very easy to next-to-impossible
Kidzone play structure with slides and kid’s bouldering
Minimum age to boulder is 10 years old
Minimum age to belay is 14 years old
Children 13 and under must be supervised at ratio 2 children to 1 adult (adult must be 18+)
Must be 16 or older to access training area or be supervised by a coach
Lead course requires climbing regularly, 6 months top-roping experience, able to flash 5.10 climbs
Lead test requires own rope, Grigri, locking carabiner; partner required
Birthday parties minimum 4 children, maximum 12 children; 1 staff per 4 children

blurb: Guests climb on top ropes, auto belays, and bouldering walls of varying difficulty. The gym offers lessons including lead climbing courses and private coaching. Children have supervised areas and programs including a Kidzone and birthday parties.
extraNote: $100 non-refundable deposit required for birthday parties; full payment due Thursday before party; no refunds after payment · Cancellations for parties non-refundable and may not be rescheduled within 48 hours of event; new deposit required to reschedule · Monthly memberships have $30 activation fee and can be frozen for $8/month · Lead course lessons must be paid in full beforehand; no combined discounts · No reservations required to climb except for lessons which must be booked online in advance · Main building entrance on Carlaw Avenue or back entrance off Thackery St.
